senses.definition: athletic facility equipped for sports or physical training
of or relating to or used in exercises intended to develop strength and agility
a sport that involves exercises intended to display strength and balance and agility
a laborer who moves from place to place as demanded by employment

a member of a people with dark skin and hair who speak Romany and who traditionally live by seasonal work and fortunetelling; they are believed to have originated in northern India but now are living on all continents (but mostly in Europe, North Africa, and North America)
a person who resembles a Romani in leading an unconventional, nomadic way of life
the Indic language of the Romani
